work.title: Inventory 10054
work.description: Mixed-media collage incorporating target concentric circles, two footballs, a small photographic insert depicting a red automobile, handwritten text listing names, and gestural ink markings across a white ground. Cutout figures, gear forms, a syringe illustration, and typed numerals '10054' layer over painted spiral and radiating motifs in red, black, and yellow.
work.composition: central black panel with corner-football anchors
